subject.statement: Charlie Javice was sentenced to 85 months in prison for defrauding JPMorgan.

summary: Bottom line: Charlie Javice was sentenced to 85 months in prison for defrauding JPMorgan Chase (TRUE, 91% confidence). The sentence was imposed on September 30, 2025 (effective date of incarceration) following a hearing on September 29, 2025 before Judge Alvin K. Hellerstein. She founded Frank in 2017, served as its CEO, and sold the company to JPMorgan Chase in September 2021 for $175 million. Her full legal name is Charlie Javice.
